protocol.dataset: Amazon Shopping Queries / ESCI Task 1, reduced version
protocol.selection: Sort eligible query IDs by SHA256(shoplens-esci-v1|42|split|query_id), take first 500, independent of labels and text.
protocol.candidate_policy: Complete official query candidate list, without pruning, reretrieval, or adding unjudged items.
protocol.adapter_selection: Clothing seed42 selected exports fixed before ESCI test labels are read; no best-domain selection.
protocol.dense_score: Cosine of matching base/LoRA query and title embeddings, without recommendation heads or image signals.
protocol.query_instruction: Given a shopping request, retrieve product descriptions that match the user's needs.

tfidf.fit: Distinct candidate titles of the preselected 500 official training queries only.

protocol.configuration_selection: Fixed settings, no ESCI tuning or ESCI fine-tuning. No development subset required.
protocol.dcg: sum(gain / log2(rank+1)), using linear gains, not 2**gain-1
protocol.gain_mapping_discrepancy: prepare_trec_eval_files.py maps S to qrel 2 and C to 3, then declares qrel gains 0.01 and 0.1 respectively. Report that reversed S/C mapping as a separate sensitivity.
protocol.aggregation: Unweighted arithmetic mean over the 500 selected test queries
protocol.no_exact_items: Exact MRR and recall=0, retained and counted
protocol.scope: A deterministic 500-query labelled candidate-list transfer benchmark, not full-catalogue retrieval or a replication of the published ESCI baseline.

declaration: Written before loading ESCI test relevance labels. Parameters and Clothing transfer adapters are fixed.
